Agent Name: WebSurfer

Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly concluded that only 1 paper met the criteria. In step 4, WebSurfer clicked on a single search result ("Statistical Learning and Inverse Problems...") and assumed this was the only relevant paper or failed to continue searching for other papers authored by "Yuri" that might also have a "certain" recommendation. The correct answer is 3, implying there were at least two other papers missed during the browsing process. The agent stopped gathering data prematurely after finding one match instead of exhaustively searching the conference submissions to count all qualifying papers.
